## Running Code

Load tidyverse abd tge data set

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
fish_data <- read.csv("../Gaeta_etal_CLC_data.csv")
```

```{r}
head(fish_data)
```

```{r}
fish_data2 <- fish_data |> 
  summarise(min_scale_length = min(scalelength, na.rm = T),
            max_scale_length = max(scalelength, na.rm = T),
            mean_scale_length = mean(scalelength, na.rm = T))
fish_data2
```
